collection.name: supportCollisions
collection.doc: 🚛 Vehicle collision with a bridge support or soffit (EN 1991-2, 4.7): design force in driving direction and across it, height of the line of action and position along the bridge.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: 🚛 deck | soffit (anything else is an invalid input).

fields.name: assumed_force_x
fields.doc: ➡️ Design force F_dx [N] in driving direction.

fields.name: assumed_force_y
fields.doc: ↔️ Design force F_dy [N] across the driving direction.

fields.name: height

label.en: Height of the line of action

fields.doc: ↕️ Height [m] of the line of action above the carriageway.

fields.name: position_x
fields.doc: ↔️ Position [m] of the struck support from the bridge start.
